ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the regular pentagon ABCDE has a side length of 6. A circle is drawn with A as the center and AB as the radius. What is the area of the shaded portion in the figure?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that pentagon ABCDE is a regular pentagon with side length 6,\\
it follows that $AB=AE=6$ and $\angle BAE=\frac{180^\circ \times (5−2)}{5}=108^\circ$,\\
thus, the area of the shaded region in the diagram is $\frac{108\pi \times {6}^{2}}{360}=\boxed{\frac{54}{5}\pi}$.
